question: An engineer must configure OSPF routing on Cisco Nexus 9000 Series Switches. The IP subnet of the Eth1/2 interfaces for both switches must be advertised via OSPF. However, these interfaces must not establish OSPF adjacency or send routing updates. The current OSPF adjacency over the interfaces Eth1/1 on SW1 and Eth1/1 on SW2 must remain unaffected. Which configuration must be applied to both Nexus switches to meet these requirements?
options:
interface ethernet 1/2
  ip ospf network point-to-point

interface ethernet 1/2
  no ip ospf passive-interface
theory: On Nexus switches, "ip ospf passive-interface" is applied per-interface and only suppresses OSPF hellos/ adjacency formation on that specific interface, while the interface's connected subnet is still advertised into OSPF as a normal network statement. This is different from a router-wide passive-interface default, and it leaves the existing adjacency on Eth1/1 completely untouched, satisfying the requirement to advertise Eth1/2's subnet without forming an adjacency there while Eth1/1's neighbor relationship stays intact. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 1 — OSPF Passive Interfaces)
